arm.englishDescription: The body part from the shoulder to the wrist.

arm.definitionKo: 사람의 팔처럼 본체에서 길게 뻗어 나가 상하나 좌우로 움직이는 기계의 부분.
arm.englishDescription: The part of a machine that reaches out from the body and moves up and down or left and right just as the human arm does.

arm.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일을 하는 데에 필요한 마음, 사상, 기술, 장비 등을 단단히 갖추다.
arm.englishDescription: (figurative) To arm oneself with a mindset, idea, skill, equipment, etc., necessary for doing a certain task.

arm.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일을 하는 데에 필요한 마음, 사상, 기술, 장비 등을 단단히 갖추게 하다.
arm.englishDescription: (figurative) To make another person arm himself/herself with a mindset, idea, skill, equipment, etc., necessary for doing a certain task.

availability.englishDescription: The quality of being at hand when needed.

capital.definitionKo: 한 나라의 중앙 정부가 있는 도시.
capital.englishDescription: The city where a country's central government is located.

capital.definitionKo: 정부가 있어 나라의 중심이 되는 도시.
capital.englishDescription: The city that is home to the government and serves as the center of the nation.

capital.definitionKo: 성으로 이루어진 한 나라의 수도. 서울.
capital.englishDescription: The capital of a country that is formed around a castle.

capital.definitionKo: 한 나라의 중앙 정부가 있는 곳.
capital.englishDescription: The place where the central government of a country is located.

capital.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 기초가 되거나 중심적인 역할을 하는 곳.
capital.englishDescription: A place that is the base or center of something.

capital.definitionKo: 미리 준비해 두었다가 뒤에 잇따라 가져다 쓰는 밑천.
capital.englishDescription: Seed money that one sets aside and later keeps using little by little.

capital.definitionKo: 장사나 도박을 계속해 나가기 위해 필요한 돈.
capital.englishDescription: Money necessary for carrying on with business or gambling.

capital.definitionKo: 한 나라의 중앙 정부가 있는 곳.
capital.englishDescription: The place where the nation's central government is located.

capital.definitionKo: 한 나라의 중앙 정부가 있는 곳.
capital.englishDescription: A place where the central government of a country is located.

capital.definitionKo: 장사나 사업 등을 하는 데에 바탕이 되는 돈.
capital.englishDescription: Money needed to run a business.

capital.definitionKo: 경제에서, 상품을 만드는 데에 필요한 돈과 생산 수단과 노동력.
capital.englishDescription: In economy, the money, means of production, and labor needed to produce goods.

capital.definitionKo: 이익을 얻기 위해 사업에 투자한 돈.
capital.englishDescription: Money invested in a business in order to make a profit.
Money used for running a business.

capital.definitionKo: 어떤 것의 근원이 되거나 전체를 관리하고 다스리는 곳.
capital.englishDescription: A place that is the base of something or where comprehensive affairs are managed and controlled.

eagle.definitionKo: 갈고리처럼 굽은 날카로운 부리와 발톱을 가지고 있으며 빛깔이 검은 큰 새.
eagle.englishDescription: A large, blackish bird with a sharp, hook-shaped beak and sharp talons.

engaging.definitionKo: 회사나 정당 등에 함께 일할 사람을 받아들임.
engaging.englishDescription: The act of accepting someone to work for a company, political party, etc.

ho-ho.definitionKo: 입을 둥글게 벌리고 크게 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
ho-ho.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of laughing loudly with a round, open mouth.

ill-omened.englishDescription: One's fortune or the energy of a place being bad.

jebbap.definitionKo: 제사를 지내기 위해 차려 놓은 밥.
jebbap.englishDescription: offerings: Steamed rice prepared for an ancestral rite.
offerings: Steamed rice that remains after an ancestral rite.

leisure.definitionKo: 일을 하지 않는 시간. 또는 일을 하는 중간에 생기는 여유로운 시간.
leisure.englishDescription: The time when one is not working; or the time for relaxation in the middle of working.

leisure.definitionKo: 일이나 공부를 하지 않아도 되는 자유롭고 한가한 때. 또는 그 시간을 이용해 편안하게 노는 일.
leisure.englishDescription: Time free from work or duties, or using that time to relax comfortably.

myeo.definitionKo: 잇달아 쓰인 둘 이상의 비슷한 사물을 이어 주는 조사.
myeo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that connects two or more similar objects that are written consecutively.

plain.englishDescription: Simple and plain.

plain.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
plain.englishDescription: A situation or circumstances being so clear and apparent as to be understood even without careful consideration.
Plain, neither luxurious nor showy.
A field with grass.
The taste of food feeling refreshing, not greasy.

plain.definitionKo: 보기 좋고 그럴듯하게 만드는 것 없이 있는 그대로 진실되다.
plain.englishDescription: Something being faithful to what it actually is without being artificially made to look nicer.

plain.definitionKo: 글이나 말의 내용이 꾸밈이 없어 주관적이지 않고 차분하다.
plain.englishDescription: Straightforward, objective, and calm in writing or speech .

plain.definitionKo: 맛이 짜거나 느끼하지 않고 싱거운 듯 산뜻하다.
plain.englishDescription: Neither salty nor greasy, flat but clean tasting.
Tasting fresh, not oily.
A vast expanse of fields.
An expanse of flat, broad land.
Not pretty or good-looking.
Common without distinct features or changes.
Wide, flat, open land with no fences, etc.

plain.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
plain.englishDescription: A situation or reasons being so clear and distinct as to be figured out even without careful consideration.
The taste of food not being strong but mild.

plain.definitionKo: 물건의 품질이나 겉모양, 또는 사람의 옷차림 등이 돋보이거나 화려하지 않고 평범하면서도 검소하다.
plain.englishDescription: The quality or appearance of something, or one's dress, being ordinary and humble, neither too conspicuous nor fancy.
A wide field whose surface is flat.
A vast, flat field.
Easy, neither picky nor difficult.
One's looks or appearance looking common and ordinary.

precipitation.definitionKo: 일정한 기간 동안 일정한 곳에 비나 눈 등이 내려 생기는 물의 양.
precipitation.englishDescription: The quantity of water that comes from rain or snow that fall on a particular location during a particular period of time.

precipitation.definitionKo: 일정 기간 동안 일정한 곳에 내린 비의 양.
precipitation.englishDescription: The amount of rain that fell on a certain location during a certain period of time.

precipitation.definitionKo: 액체 속에 들어 있는 물질이 밑바닥으로 가라앉음. 또는 그 물질.
precipitation.englishDescription: An act of a substance contained in a liquid sinking to the bottom, or such a substance.

slovenia.definitionKo: 동유럽에 있는 나라. 주요 생산물로는 석유, 납, 아연, 수은 등이 있다. 공용어는 슬로베니아어이고 수도는 류블랴나이다.
slovenia.englishDescription: A country located in eastern Europe; it is a major producer of oil, lead, zinc, mercury, etc.; its official language is Slovene and its capital is Ljubljana.

sprain.definitionKo: 손이나 발과 같은 신체의 일부가 비틀려서 뼈마디가 어긋나다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
sprain.englishDescription: For a part of one's body, such as a hand or foot, to twist, resulting in the dislocation of a bone from its knuckle or joint, or to make this happen.

sprain.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분이 충격을 받아 접히거나 비틀려서 뼈마디가 어긋나다.
sprain.englishExpression: have a wrick in; sprain; wrench
sprain.englishDescription: For a joint of a part of one's body to be twisted or bent strongly and dislocated.

sprain.definitionKo: 심한 충격으로 지나치게 접혀서 삔 지경에 이르다.
sprain.englishDescription: For a part of one's body to be bent excessively due to a big shock, and be sprained.

submerge.englishDescription: To put something in a liquid or make it go down to the bottom of the liquid.
To go into water so that one's body is completely covered with water.

sun.definitionKo: 태양계의 중심에 있으며 온도가 매우 높고 스스로 빛을 내는 항성.
sun.englishDescription: The star at the center of a solar system which is extremely hot and emits light.

sun.definitionKo: 태양계의 중심에 있으며 온도가 매우 높고 스스로 빛을 내는 항성.
sun.englishDescription: The star at the center of a solar system which is extremely hot and emits light.
A compound word for the sun, the moon, and the stars.

sun.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 해를 사람처럼 비유하여 이르는 말.
sun.englishDescription: (polite form) A figurative term for the sun, used to address the sun as if it were a human being.

valid.englishDescription: Being able to use something or being effective.
Being appropriate as something stands to reason.
